news.headline: Jordyn Tyson will not practice this week
news.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said Monday that the Saints do not expect their rookie receiver to practice this week, so he will not play Sunday at the Giants. Tyson hurt a hamstring in August and has not played a game yet.

news.headline: Tyler Shough hurt his left hand
news.summary: The Saints quarterback hurt his left hand in Atlanta a week earlier, wore a glove on it Sunday and handed the ball off with his right hand instead. Asked if the hand is broken, he said he was not sure he could answer that, and said it did not bother him.

news.headline: Minnesota beats the Saints 23-13
news.summary: The Saints gained only 142 yards in the Superdome on Sunday, and Tyler Shough threw two interceptions. New Orleans has now lost three home games in a row and is 1-4.

nextGame.note: Late morning kickoff in Austin against Texas.

news.headline: Sumrall takes a bigger hand in the defense
news.summary: Jon Sumrall said Monday that he is working with the Florida defense more day to day after South Carolina scored 38 points in Gainesville. He said he is not taking the defense over from Brad White and still has a lot of confidence in that staff.

news.headline: Vernell Brown III will miss the Texas game
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Monday that the receiver is not expected to play Saturday at Texas. Sumrall said Brown is trying hard to get back on the field.

news.headline: Florida takes a star receiver away from Texas
news.summary: Easton Royal, a receiver at Brother Martin High School in New Orleans, switched his college choice from Texas to Florida on Sunday. He is rated one of the best high school receivers in the country and plans to play for the Gators.

nextGame.note: Late morning home game in Baton Rouge. Mississippi State is 4-1.

news.headline: LSU sends a touchdown play to the league office
news.summary: Coach Lane Kiffin said Monday he sent the tape of Kentucky's short fourth-down touchdown to the conference office and had not heard back. He also thought officials missed a block in the back on a 55-yard punt return, but said the calls even out over time.

news.headline: Mississippi State's quarterback may miss the LSU game
news.summary: Kamario Taylor hurt his foot against Alabama on October 3 and walked off in a boot. His coach said Monday that the team will know more on Wednesday, before Saturday's game in Baton Rouge.

news.headline: LSU drops to 22nd in the new poll
news.summary: LSU was tenth in the country before losing 35-34 at Kentucky on Saturday. The new Associated Press poll has the Tigers 22nd, and 16th-ranked Mississippi State comes to Baton Rouge on Saturday.

nextGame.note: Friday night home game at Yulman Stadium. Memphis has won five of its six games.

news.headline: Tulane's last game is set for November 28
news.summary: The conference picked Saturday, November 28, for Tulane's trip to South Florida. The kickoff time and the TV channel will be announced about two weeks before the game.

news.headline: Army beats Tulane 20-17 on the last play
news.summary: Army kicked a field goal as time ran out at West Point on Saturday. Tulane had tied the game late on a 39-yard touchdown pass from Kadin Semonza to Jaylin Lucas, and hosts Memphis next Friday night.

news.headline: Tulane loses a starting lineman to injury
news.summary: Nose tackle Kam Hamilton was helped off the field early in the fourth quarter at Army with a leg injury and did not come back. Coach Will Hall said he does not know how long Hamilton will be out, and Tulane was already missing its other starting inside lineman.

nextGame.note: Thursday night road game in River Ridge, and a district game. John Curtis has won two games and lost four.

news.headline: Easton Royal picks Florida over Texas
news.summary: The Brother Martin receiver had been committed to Texas since last November. He switched to Florida on Sunday, a day after a visit to the Florida campus.

news.headline: Brother Martin drops out of the state top 10
news.summary: Friday's loss to Rummel moved Brother Martin out of the Crescent City Sports top 10 for the biggest class. The Crusaders are 4-2 and play at John Curtis on Thursday.

news.headline: Rummel beats Brother Martin 33-10
news.summary: Brother Martin kicked a field goal to start Friday afternoon at Tad Gormley Stadium, then lost two fumbles and never caught up. It is a second loss in a row and Brother Martin is now 4-2.
